findings.description: The coder's final message contains no test execution output, no Word document validation, no confirmation of the 6-table structure, and no landscape orientation check. Add and document test execution results before approval.
Column widths use Inches(col_widths[0] / 1440) which converts twips to inches then back incorrectly. Should use Pt or set widths directly on table columns. Fix the column width implementation.

findings.issue: Bullet point rendering breaks non-bullet text
findings.description: add_bulleted_lines converts all lines not starting with '-' into plain text but adds bullet '•' to lines starting with '-', creating asymmetric handling. Multi-paragraph text without bullets gets collapsed. Refine the logic to preserve paragraph structure.
generate_word_document processes only first_frap from JSON without warning when multiple FRAPs exist. This violates the principle of least surprise. Either process all FRAPs or log a warning.

findings.issue: Missing error handling for table structure
findings.description: No validation that table 1 is a dict, that tables 2-6 exist, or that JSON structure matches expected format before attempting table creation. Add structure validation with clear error messages.
